To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the price elasticity for long-haul tourism is more inelastic than that for short-haul tourism; the income elasticity for long-hail tourism is more elastic than that for short- haul tourism; the exchange rate elasticity is more inelastic for long-haul tourists than for short-haul tourists; and the transportation cost elasticity is more in elastic for long-haul trips than for short-hail trips.
long-haul tourism has a lower income elasticity, a higher price elasticity, and a lower exchange rate elasticity than short-haul tourism.
